brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape approximately 16:9, 1600x900 or larger than 1000 px wide. It is for バスケまとめ, article dated 2026.11.11. This is new artwork, not a photograph.

Approved art direction: near-black #151A18 background, vivid acid-lime #CCF43B accents, warm white giant bold Japanese typography, rough hand-painted ink/brush sports illustration, a few expressive diagonal brush strokes, strong contrast, restrained elements. Follow the black/lime approved sample seen in this conversation in visual quality, but make a new composition and copy NONE of its old names, scores, dates, or shooting pose.

Subject: exactly ONE real player, Jake Van Tubbergen (ジェイク・ヴァン・タバーゲン), selected randomly from the article's named players. Draw him recognizably in energetic basketball play, not a made-up athlete. Appearance was checked in his official San-en profile photo: light skin, tall lean athletic build; short tousled dark brown hair with irregular forward/side-swept fringe, short sides; angular elongated face and firm jaw, pronounced straight nose, focused deep-set eyes under fairly straight brows, light moustache and short chin goatee, very short jaw stubble, visible slightly prominent ears. Reproduce these observed identity features in a hand-drawn ink illustration. Skin and uniform rendered mostly warm-white and black with subtle muted warm skin tones; no photorealism, no photographic texture, no pasted photo. Sleeveless plain dark basketball jersey with a little light piping, absolutely no team logos, league logos, sponsors, player name, or jersey number.

Composition: place player on the LEFT roughly 44% of image, torso leaning forward in a powerful drive while gathering an orange basketball with both hands near the hip, shown in 3/4 front view with face clearly visible looking toward the open space. Waist/thigh-up crop is fine, but the entire head, both arms, both hands and the basketball must be visible, anatomically coherent and contained inside the canvas. Both hands must have natural fingers and grip. Convey forward movement through the body's diagonal posture and brush strokes, not through extra limbs or duplicate balls. Do not draw another person, hoop, opponent, crowd, or detailed arena. This is an imagined generic basketball action illustration, NOT a recreation of an actual game moment, shot, score or highlight.

On the RIGHT roughly 52%, a beautifully balanced text block with generous safe margin and big crisp lettering. Required visible text only, verbatim:
Top small masthead: 「バスケまとめ」
Date: 「2026.11.11」
Largest headline on two separate lines: 「試合結果」 and 「当日のEFF」
Prominent lime subheading: 「ポジション別TOP3」
Small league line: 「B.PREMIER」
Smaller secondary line: 「B.ONE・B.NEXTは試合なし」
Readable bottom labels on a clean dark strip: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」

The date is the ARTICLE DATE, not an appearance label for the randomly selected subject. Keep copy as article-wide reporting. Do NOT add the player's name, individual stats, points, rebounds, assists, rank, MVP, victory language, or any assertion about his performance/appearance. TOP3 means article-wide position-based official daily EFF ranking; do not visually crown the depicted player as #1. Never import the sample's 38 points, Culver, Sendai/Kobe or 10/19. No extra text. Preserve all Japanese spelling and exact numbers, especially 2026.11.11 and TOP3. All text and the AI label must remain legible at thumbnail scale.

SINGLE ALLOWED CORRECTION
Edit the FIRST image, the existing finished black/lime Japanese basketball thumbnail. The SECOND image is the official portrait of the SAME real player Jake Van Tubbergen and is provided ONLY as an appearance reference. It is not an insert: do not paste any photograph, logo, uniform branding, flames or red lighting into the design.

Make ONE targeted correction to the illustrated player on the LEFT: his hair/head currently touches and is cropped by the upper edge. Slightly reduce and reposition the whole player-and-ball illustration within its current left portion so the ENTIRE top of his hair has a clear 35 to 50 px dark margin above it, while both hands, both arms and the basketball remain entirely inside the canvas. His waist may be cropped at bottom, but no head, fingers or ball may be clipped. Maintain the dynamic low forward driving/gathering pose, anatomically natural arms and fingers, and recognizable identity. Use the second image to refine likeness in the same hand-drawn ink/brush style: substantially shorter dark brown hair, a low tousled side/forward fringe rather than a tall voluminous quiff; the angular elongated face, deep-set focused eyes, straight prominent nose, slightly prominent ears, small moustache and close short chin goatee seen in the official portrait. Render an illustrated face, not a photographic one. No new person, no extra limbs, no jersey number, no player name, no logos.

Preserve the first image's canvas size, palette, entire RIGHT text block, exact spelling and line placement, headline, date, all labels, brush-work art direction and orange ball. Preserve every visible text verbatim:
バスケまとめ
2026.11.11
試合結果
当日のEFF
ポジション別TOP3
B.PREMIER
B.ONE・B.NEXTは試合なし
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ

Do not add any statistic, personal achievement, name or new words. This is generic imagined play, not an actual scene from a match. Final output is ONE fully finished landscape PNG thumbnail.
